title.zh: Mastercard brings stablecoin balances into traditional banking and card payments
title.en: Mastercard brings stablecoin balances into traditional banking and card payments

current_state.zh: Mastercard launched its Global Money Platform, its first major BVNK integration since acquiring the stablecoin infrastructure firm in August, letting businesses hold and convert stablecoins, issue stablecoin-linked cards, and settle payments into recipients' local bank accounts, with Nuvei and Marqeta among the first adopters.
current_state.en: Mastercard launched its Global Money Platform, its first major BVNK integration since acquiring the stablecoin infrastructure firm in August, letting businesses hold and convert stablecoins, issue stablecoin-linked cards, and settle payments into recipients' local bank accounts, with Nuvei and Marqeta among the first adopters.
